To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the behaviour of HSC external beam-column connections can be enhanced by the use of a large number of column ties in the connection region and by the use of steel fibres in the concrete.
high strength concrete and/or steel fibre reinforced concrete can be used to enhance the performance of external beam column connections.

High strength concrete beam column connection specimens with a high level of tension reinforcement and with one or three column ties in the joint zone have performed better than normal strength concrete beam column specimens without column ties.
